brief.prompt: A woman with fair, freckled skin wears a fabric headband holding all her hair back from her face and stands facing a mirror in soft daylight with a bare face, chin level, studying the outline of her jaw and cheeks. The background is a simple, uncluttered bathroom with a plain wall.
brief.alt: Woman with hair pulled back checking her face proportions in a mirror before applying makeup
brief.purpose: Shows the self-check from the proportions section: hair back, even daylight and a level chin, so the reader can see where their face is widest.

review.alt: Woman with freckled skin and a fabric headband holding her hair back looks at her bare face in a bathroom mirror in soft daylight, hands touching her jawline as she checks her face proportions.
